definitions.title: Derivatives of the Six Trigonometric Functions
definitions.latex: \frac{d}{dx}[\sin x] = \cos x, \; \frac{d}{dx}[\cos x] = -\sin x, \; \frac{d}{dx}[\tan x] = \sec^2 x, \; \frac{d}{dx}[\sec x] = \sec x \tan x, \; \frac{d}{dx}[\csc x] = -\csc x \cot x, \; \frac{d}{dx}[\cot x] = -\csc^2 x
definitions.statement: The derivatives of all six trigonometric functions exist wherever the functions are defined, with radian measure assumed throughout.
conditions: x is in the domain of the respective trig function
definitions.explanation: Notice the cofunction pattern: every 'co' function (cosine, cotangent, cosecant) has a negative sign in its derivative.
definitions.keyTakeaway: All 'co' trigonometric derivatives have a negative sign.
